--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT DISTINCT
    BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BTP.AUTH_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BTP.PROD_CODE AS ProductId
    ,BTPD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BTP.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BTP.BNK_CODE
    FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO_DELTA BTPD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO BTP ON BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO = BTPD.PORTFOLIO_NO AND BTP.BASE_NO = BTPD.BASE_NO AND BTP.ACC_NO = BTPD.ACC_NO AND BTP.isLatest = '1'
  )

SELECT *  FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
WHERE CustomerAccountId in ('4779a4ff111f5b037c0b7db085028443','85e8f9e6c9a3389818c4d7dc1cb1b3e6');
